subject.title: fix: keep the global loop breaker reachable after tool blocks

question: Should the loop-history contract represent the detector’s own veto as a typed `loop-veto` outcome in this PR, or use the sentinel-hash design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same confirmed availability bug with real terminal proof, but they encode the long-lived loop-history invariant differently; source review alone cannot choose the intended canonical representation.

options.title: Adopt typed outcome representation
options.body: Merge this PR after normal refresh, keeping `loop-veto` distinct from real hashed tool results and closing the sentinel-hash alternative.

options.title: Adopt sentinel-hash representation
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109619 instead and close this PR as superseded once that implementation lands.

recommendation.title: Adopt typed outcome representation
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after normal refresh, keeping `loop-veto` distinct from real hashed tool results and closing the sentinel-hash alternative.
